checks.lead: Ali ibn Yusuf (also known as Ali Ben Youssef; Arabic: علي بن يوسف; c. 1084 – 28 January 1143) was an Almoravid emir who ruled the Almoravid dynasty from 1106 until his death in 1143. He succeeded his father, Yusuf ibn Tashfin, and was succeeded by his son, Tashfin ibn Ali.
